#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The effective entitlements. |
| `data.feature_key` | `string` | The feature key. |
| `data.feature_name` | `string` | The feature name. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The feature type. One of `switch`, `quota`, `meter`. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The feature unit. |
| `data.value` | `string` | The value: `true` or `false` for a switch, an integer or `unlimited` otherwise. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Where the value comes from: the plan, or an override on the subscription. One of `plan`, `override`. |
| `data.reset` | `object` | When the allowance resets for this subscription (a credits link is resolved). Null = the next invoice's usage window. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Effective entitlements |
| `404` | No such subscription |
